description: Machine-generated session-start orientation cache. Produced by /workday-start and /workstream-start to give the EM a pre-computed structural snapshot of the repo state without requiring Tier-4 exploration. Re-generated each workday; not a lifecycle record. Spec backlink: docs/wiki/tiered-context-loading.md § Tier 0. The optional `## Priorities` section (C8, 2026-07-27, docs/plans/2026-07-26-priority-ledger.md) is READ-MOSTLY: it surfaces each ready-to-fire handoff's RESOLVED effective priority (via the single `resolve_priority` walk, `claude-klabauter coordinator_core/ops/emit/priority_resolve.py`) for the EM to read at session start — it is never a set/adjust affordance, and the section is full-regen-only (omitted, never re-derived, by the `--pinboard-only` fast path in `orientation/regenerate_cache.py`). Each bullet: `- **<handoff title>:** <priority|cleared> (<explicit|inherited|suggested|ambiguous>)`. The section is omitted entirely when no ready handoff resolves to a non-`none` origin.

generated_by.description: Skill or command that produced this cache (e.g. workday-start).

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp this cache was generated (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

git_head_at_generation.description: Git branch or ref HEAD was pointing at when the cache was generated. Anchors the snapshot for stale-detection.
